name: paid-ads-squad
description: Paid-advertising squad: google-ads-agent and meta-ads-agent each run one ad account end to end — daily optimization, diagnostics, digests, and reviews — filed to the board.
author: pancake-official

workflows.summary: Run a full Google Ads optimization sweep and ship every reversible fix within the existing budget.

scope.description: Campaign or campaign type to focus the sweep on (defaults to the whole account).

workflows.outcome: Reversible fixes (negatives, bids, creative pauses, asset rotations, settings, in-total reallocations) shipped; any budget-raise opportunity surfaced on the board; the sweep filed as a routine ticket.

workflows.summary: Compile the 3-section Google Ads daily digest from the last 24h of activity.
workflows.outcome: A ~200-word 3-section digest filed on the board as a digest ticket for the co-founder to relay.

workflows.summary: Investigate a Google Ads metric regression and propose or ship the reversible fix.

scope.description: Campaign or ad group to scope the investigation to (defaults to account-wide).

workflows.outcome: Root-cause diagnosis filed; reversible fixes shipped; any spend-increasing remedy surfaced on the board.

workflows.summary: Apply an approved budget raise or launch an opted-in campaign and verify pacing.

campaign.description: The campaign the approved change applies to.

change.description: The approved budget raise or campaign launch to apply, verbatim from the approval ticket.

workflows.outcome: Approved budget change applied, logged to the daily log, and confirmed back on the ticket.

workflows.summary: Run the daily Meta Ads diagnostic + action sweep (eight-branch root cause), executing autonomous-allowed actions.
workflows.outcome: Autonomous actions executed and audit-logged; budget-commitment actions queued; the sweep filed as a routine ticket.

workflows.summary: Compose the 7-section Meta Ads daily digest from today's audit log and approval queue.
workflows.outcome: The structured daily digest filed to the wiki and on the board as a digest ticket for the co-founder to relay.

workflows.summary: Run the adaptive Meta Ads weekly review (folds in monthly audits on the first Monday of a month, quarterly on the first Monday of a quarter).
workflows.outcome: Weekly/monthly/quarterly report filed to the wiki and summarized on the board as a digest ticket.

workflows.summary: Run an ad-hoc Meta Ads root-cause investigation on a specific entity or question.

entity.description: The campaign, ad set, or ad to investigate.

question.description: What to investigate, in plain language.
question.example: Why did CPA double on Friday?

workflows.outcome: Investigation findings filed; any reversible fix shipped and audit-logged; results filed on the ticket.

required_vault_secrets.label: Google Ads customer ID (10 digits, no dashes)
Google Ads login/MCC customer ID, if managed under an MCC (10 digits, no dashes; leave blank if direct)
Meta Marketing API System User access token (long-lived, never expires)
Meta Pixel ID (for measurement and EMQ tracking)
CAPI Gateway dataset ID (optional — leave blank if not using CAPI Gateway)
Account currency (ISO 4217, e.g. USD, GBP, EUR)
Business model: ecommerce | lead_gen | saas | app | local | dual
Account maturity: nascent | developing | established | advanced
Primary KPI: cpa | roas | cpl | cpv | cpm
Numeric target for the primary KPI (e.g. 45.00 for $45 CPA, 4.0 for 4x ROAS)
Critical/warning thresholds as JSON (overrides skill-01 defaults — leave blank for defaults)
Campaign/ad-set/ad name templates as JSON (enables automated segmentation parsing — leave blank for defaults)
